review_method: Read all 31 saved diff sections, inspect each source/expected diagnostic and the unchanged rejection exit path; independently verify exact inventory/timing coverage. No compiler, backend, benchmark or native executable was run.
status_evidence_limit: All 16 unequal status pairs are explicitly logged as 1 -> 0. The 15 equal rejection status pairs are established by unchanged oracle status comparison and diagnostics.fail()->sys.exit(1); the oracle does not retain individual equal status numbers. The 4407 identical inputs include both successful compilations and rejection fixtures.
comparison_scope: IR bytes and exit statuses are compared exactly. The repository oracle retains its existing narrow library-location normalization for diagnostics; this run adds no further normalization and changes only SHOW=3 to SHOW=4438.
runtime_limit: This classification is a compile/diagnostic oracle result, not execution or performance evidence for the newly accepted programs.

unchanged_controls.reason: This pre-existing CPython-vs-Pystachy syntax-diagnostic discrepancy is unchanged between the two Pystachy compilers. It remains an intentional rejection, not a new match regression.
Directly declared @property on special method __match_args__ is rejected before match lowering by both compilers, so this fifteenth new negative fixture does not appear among the differences.
